# Source register

Every document used on this project, with the user's classification. **Don't open a document that isn't
listed here.** Ask the user first, then add a row.

Classifications: **SoT** (source of truth, state for what: behaviour / intent / interface / I/O / HMI) ·
**WIP** (verify before use) · **Superseded** (ignore) · **Do not open** (user decision).
